Author: Siddharth
Bench: Siddharth
High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
?Neutral Citation No. - 2023:Ahc:181101
Court No. - 64
Case :- Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. - 27796 of 2023
Applicant :- Monu
Opposite Party :- State of U.P.

entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Counsel for Applicant :- Rama Shankar Mishra,Pawan Kumar Bhardwaj,Pramod Bhardwaj

Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.,Rajesh Kumar Singh Hon'ble Siddharth,J.
Heard learned counsel for the applicant and counsel for the informant as also learned A.G.A. for the State.

The instant bail application has been filed on behalf of the applicant, Monu, with a prayer to release him on bail in Case Crime No. 118 of 2022, under Sections- 498A, 304B, 504,323 I.P.C. and 3/4 Dowry Prohibition Act, Police Station - Shikarpur, District - Bulandshahar.
This Court after hearing the learned counsels for the parties does not finds any ground for enlarging the applicant on bail at this stage.
The bail application is accordingly, rejected.

preferable within a period of one year from the date of production of certified copy of this order.
